newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINA TO TRAIN IN BRITAIN FOR WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA TO TRAIN IN BRITAIN FOR WORLD CUP.

text.p: China's soccer team, hoping to make a first appearance in the World Cup finals next year, will train in Britain next month, the China news service said on Wednesday.

The team, who play Iran on September 13 in their first match of the final Asian World Cup qualifying round, would travel to London on August 11 for 10 days of training and would play matches against three English teams, it said.
The Chinese team would also play friendlies against Kazakhstan, the United Arab Emirates and Cameroon in China before meeting Iran.
